summary: Granular vessels now render as procedural course tubes in 3D and in the 2D live section/PiP, and no vessel record draws a schematic placement ellipsoid any more (the two red lenticulostriate blobs are retired). FILES: (1) NEW src/geometry/vasculature-courses.ts — VesselCourseRecord (a TractRecord superset: id/name/region/kind/laterality/parent/surface/surfaceNote/basis/elementIds/anchorNote/territory/supply/direction/modality/origin/target/decussation/function/waypoints/tubeRadius/calibreMm/color/clinical/refs), VesselCourseGroup (a record whose body is its child courses), VESSEL_COURSES/VESSEL_COURSE_IDS/VESSEL_COURSE_GROUPS, hasVesselCourse (the suppression key — true for a drawing course AND for a group, false otherwise), hasVesselCourseGroup, vesselCourseById, vesselCourseGroupById, isPairedVessel (registry laterality first, record fallback), mirrorVesselWaypoints/mirrorVesselCourse, vesselTubeCount (2 x paired + 1 x midline terms), readAuthoredVesselCourses + mergeVesselCourses (import.meta.glob over src/data/structures/vasculature-course*.json; authored wins by id; a built-in record whose id gains an authored `<id>-1…` ladder becomes a GROUP so its tube is withdrawn instead of duplicating its children; unusable/aliased entries are rejected/reported, never silently dropped). Built-in PLAN.md §2.1 Tier-1 lenticulostriate courses are always in force, so the blob fix never depends on a sibling task: vasc-lenticulostriate-arteries (the shared M1→anterior-perforated-substance trunk, 0.333 au / 0.8 mm), vasc-lateral-lenticulostriate-arteries and vasc-medial-lenticulostriate-arteries (Heubner, 0.417 au / 1.0 mm) authored from the PLAN §3.1/§3.2 measured landmarks, surface null with the reason stated. (2) src/components/viewer3d/SceneLayers.tsx — imports the vessel table, adds exported vesselCoursesVisible(courses, layers) (the same isTractVisible one-decision gate; reads the record's own region/kind so only the Vasculature area + vessel system control them), a visibleVesselCourses memo and a TractTube pass that mounts the authored tube plus `<TractTube mirrored>` for every paired course, and the suppression line `if (hasVesselCourse(record.id)) return null` beside the nerve one (v17 comment updated). (3) src/components/section/sectionAssets.ts — the v14 nerve route is generalized into ONE shared adapter `registryCourseParts(courses, authoredPartFor, mirroredPartFor, isPaired)`; registryNerveParts() keeps its v14 call shape and its 24 parts, registryVesselParts() returns the vessel parts (authored + `#mirror`, slug suffix, group = the course id), registryCoursePartsAll() and SECTION_VESSEL_PARTS/SECTION_VESSEL_PARTS metas (taxonomyKind 'vessel', region 'vasculature'), partsForCanvas() = SECTION_PARTS + SECTION_NERVE_PARTS + SECTION_VESSEL_PARTS. BUG FIXED (inherited, affects nerves too): the mirrored 2D part was swept with the default id cache key, so tubeGeometryFor returned the AUTHORED geometry and the 'mirror' part duplicated the authored side; both families now sweep the twin under `${id}#mirror`, the same key TractTube's mirrored instance uses. (4) NEW scripts/verify/vessel-render.mjs — 75 assertions printed with numbers: the merged table (built-in surviving / replaced / authored terms, per-course id/laterality/parent/surface/basis/points/arc-mm/radius/calibre-mm), the 3D pass over 7 layer states (40 courses with all on; vessel kind off → 0; vasculature area off → 0; tract kind off leaves them; nervous system off leaves them; hidden preset hides one) with the tube count printed as 40 authored + 37 mirrored = 77, the one-body-per-record table over all 51 vessel structure records (0 blobs; all 7 lenticulostriate records suppressed), the 2D registry (SECTION_PARTS still 138, 40 vessel metas, 77 worker parts = 2 x 37 paired + 1 x 3 midline printed as terms, indices in range, isPartVisible on/off per meta), the shipped contour worker slicing every course (2241 loops, 0 non-finite), the shared-builder check (185,493 position values identical between tubeGeometryFor and registryVesselParts, and the nerve mirror bboxes negated = the inherited bug stays fixed), synthetic merge/group/alias cases (the live data no longer exercises the group path), and the payload proof (138 manifest parts, Σ 14,486,228 B = 13.82 MiB, 599,204 tris, 0 course GLBs). VERIFICATION: npm run check exit 0; npm run build exit 0; node scripts/verify/vessel-render.mjs exit 0 (75/75); npm run validate 0 errors/0 warnings; view-filter-consistency 102/102; cranial-nerve-courses 220/220; cranial-nerves 451/451; nerve-kind 79/79; somatotopy 45/45; cortical-lobes; division-toggles 251/251; pip-contract 187/187; boundary-contract 22/22; a11y-contract 38/38; budget-report; closure-bite 92/92; audit-checks 92/92; plane-transform 10,827; plane-helper-extent 206; section-pipeline 138/138; imaging-v4/-v4b — all exit 0. TWO RE-POINT TARGETS for the final reviewer (both count-derived, neither satisfied by bending the product, both caused by the PLAN §5.2 row-5 mandate that partsForCanvas() grows): scripts/verify/cranial-nerve-render.mjs:362 (`partsForCanvas().length === SECTION_PARTS.length + SECTION_NERVE_PARTS.length` → add `+ SECTION_VESSEL_PARTS.length`; 150 → 190, its only failure, 46/47) and scripts/verify/area-toggles.mjs:1693 (`canvasParts.length, 138 + 12` → `138 + 12 + SECTION_VESSEL_PARTS.length`). area-toggles' other five lane-9 failures are the pre-existing v17 mirror drift at area-toggles.mjs:1713-1724 (registryNerveParts 12 vs 24) documented in PLAN §7.9. ONE HANDOFF outside this task's write scope, printed by the gate on every run: SectionCanvas.tsx's init-registry effect appends `registryParts.push(...registryNerveParts())`; adding `registryParts.push(...registryVesselParts())` on the next line is what hands the worker the vessel geometry (the visible-list side, partsForCanvas(), already carries the vessel metas, and the 2D machinery is proven by execution) — without it the vessel contours are computed but not painted. npm script line wanted from the integrator: "verify:vessel-render": "node scripts/verify/vessel-render.mjs". Deviations from PLAN.md: the vessel table lives in src/geometry/vasculature-courses.ts rather than curves.ts (the dispatch's exclusive scopes give curves.ts to nobody; the shape, sweep and section adapter are shared with the nerve route as §5.1 requires), and the gate is named vessel-render.mjs (the brief's name) rather than vessel-course-render.mjs. Browser claims (that the tubes paint, that the blobs are gone on screen, that the section paints the contours) are the orchestrator's, not this gate's; verify:anatomy and verify:imaging-fit remain environment-blocked (spawnSync EPERM) as documented.
